content.title: Does Fairfax’s Bigger Bet on Under Armour (UAA) Clarify the Brand’s Turnaround Narrative?
content.summary: In late December, Fairfax Holdings, already a major shareholder in Under Armour, disclosed in a regulatory filing that it had increased its stake in the sports apparel company through a series of additional share purchases. This deeper commitment from a long-term institutional investor underscores rising confidence in Under Armour’s brand repositioning and direct-to-consumer focus. We’ll now consider how Fairfax’s increased ownership stake may influence Under Armour’s investment narrative...

content.title: Under Armour Stock Rises After the ‘Warren Buffett of Canada’ Boosts Its Stake
content.summary: Now, a firm founded by the so-called Warren Buffett of Canada is taking a bigger stake in the company.  Shares of the sneaker and apparel maker got a boost after Toronto-based  Fairfax Financial Holdings  disclosed a roughly 22% stake in the company in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday.  As of Dec. 30, Fairfax owned 42 million Class A shares, according to the Schedule 13D filing.
